issue_context.title: TiDB drops the nullable type info when implicit cast happen for bit functions
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

create table t2(a int primary key,b bigint);
alter table t2 set tiflash replica 1;
insert into t2 values(1,2);
insert into t2 values(2,3);
insert into t2 values(3,null);
set @@tidb_enforce_mpp=on;
select count(*) from t2 group by a having bit_and(b) >1;

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)
expect 1,1,1
### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
but got 
-- ERROR 1105 (HY000): Cannot convert NULL value to non-Nullable type
### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)
Release Version: v5.4.0-alpha-662-g8d133648f-dirty
Edition: Community
Git Commit Hash: 8d133648fcd3151350488b5ccb3d125fe8e9d566
Git Branch: master
UTC Build Time: 2022-01-06 11:23:45
GoVersion: go1.16
Race Enabled: false
TiKV Min Version: v3.0.0-60965b006877ca7234adaced7890d7b029ed1306
Check Table Before Drop: false |

review_comments:
Looks like we have a similar problem in other functions, like coalesce, if... you can double-check.
Prefer to define an interface like "nullable(args []Expression) bool" and force every function to implement it. So that next time we add a new function, we won't forget to consider the null handling.
Nice comments, I'll discuss it with @fzhedu.
